parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the paged query.
Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of rows per page for the paged query.
Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The filter keyword for fuzzy match when querying the list.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description:
The database account name.
Certain reserved keywords such as SYS and root cannot be used.
